notes: Enumerated every .endpoint[...] access in drivers/net/usb/**, drivers/net/wireless/**, drivers/net/wwan (no matches) of snapshots/s02. Every USB-descriptor endpoint[] index is either (a) loop-bounded by desc.bNumEndpoints of the same altsetting, (b) guarded by an explicit bNumEndpoints comparison, or (c) taken only as an address whose NULL case is rejected immediately. Strongest near-miss qmi_wwan.c:674 (&info->control->cur_altsetting->endpoint[0] without bNumEndpoints check) is safe because the USB core leaves the endpoint array NULL for zero-endpoint altsettings (drivers/usb/core/config.c:561-565), &NULL[0] evaluates to NULL, and qmi_wwan.c:676 rejects !dev->status before any dereference; wdm_create (cdc-wdm.c:811-813) further validates the descriptor. hso.c:2773 remains unresolved (intr_endp NULL-check at assignment site unread). Result: bounded negative, no reportable finding.
